condition: Peri-operative anticoagulation — mechanical mitral valve (bridging indicated)
summary: 59-year-old man with a mechanical mitral valve on warfarin (INR 3.1) listed for elective open incisional hernia repair with mesh.

inputs.hpi: Symptomatic incisional hernia after a previous laparotomy, listed for elective open mesh repair. Mechanical mitral valve replacement (bileaflet) in 2016 for rheumatic mitral stenosis; warfarin, target INR 3.0. Sinus rhythm. No bleeding problems.

exam.general: Well. HR 72 regular, BP 130/80, RR 14, SpO2 98% on air, T 36.6°C.
exam.abdomen: Reducible incisional hernia, 6 cm defect, upper midline scar.

comorbidities: Mechanical mitral valve replacement 2016 (rheumatic mitral stenosis)

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Incisional hernia — elective open mesh repair; mechanical mitral valve on warfarin
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic incisional hernia for elective open mesh repair. Mechanical mitral valve on warfarin — high thrombotic risk, bridging required.

mustInclude.note: Mechanical mitral valve: interrupt warfarin with therapeutic heparin bridging.

mustExclude.note: DOACs are contraindicated with mechanical valves.
Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: ACCP guideline — perioperative management of antithrombotic therapy
guideline.section: VKA: stop 5 days before surgery; in AF suggest against heparin bridging; suggest bridging for mechanical mitral valve; DOAC: interrupt 1 day before low/moderate bleed-risk and 2 days before high bleed-risk procedures, no heparin bridging, no pre-operative coagulation testing; aspirin: continue in patients with coronary stents; P2Y12 inhibitors: stop clopidogrel/ticagrelor 5 days and prasugrel 7 days before surgery; defer elective surgery after recent stent
guideline.citation: Douketis JD, Spyropoulos AC, Murad MH, et al. Perioperative management of antithrombotic therapy: an American College of Chest Physicians clinical practice guideline. Chest. 2022;162:e207–43.

guideline.name: 2021 ESC/EACTS guidelines — valvular heart disease
guideline.section: Mechanical valves: VKA only (DOACs contraindicated); bridging with therapeutic UFH/LMWH when VKA is interrupted for surgery
guideline.citation: Vahanian A, Beyersdorf F, Praz F, et al. Eur Heart J. 2022;43:561–632.

rationale: Permutation: the one warfarin scenario where bridging is indicated (mechanical mitral valve). A generic "bridge everyone" rule passes here and fails the base case.
